_about: Single source of truth for the in-app help. Each topic is wwwroot/help/topics/<key>.html. 'screens' maps a topic to the screens that open it from the Help button: 'Controller' matches every action of that controller, 'Controller.Action' matches one action and wins over the controller-wide entry. The in-screen panel, the Help Center, the full manual and the PDF are all built from this file and those fragments, so they cannot disagree. Groups and topics appear in the manual in the order listed here.
